ground_truth_citations.rationale: Subject wins over 210 for available-for-sale debt securities. ASC 320-10-35-1 is the subsequent-measurement sentence (fair value). ASC 210-10-45-1(f) only places marketable securities of operating cash in current assets. Unlabeled MarketableSecurities concepts may be equity securities under ASC 321, which is why this rule is expert-authored-UNVALIDATED rather than verified.

The handoff 210-10-45-7 describes: the record contains a callable-debt fact, so 470 wins over 210. ASC 470-10-45-11 requires current classification of long-term obligations callable because of a covenant violation at the balance-sheet date, unless the creditor waives the right for more than one year. Contrast R03 (no such fact), which stays 210-10-45-12.

Presentation wins. The injection moves LongTermDebtNoncurrent into current liabilities and supplies no due-on-demand, callable, or refinancing fact. ASC 210-10-45-7 hands only those three facts to 470-10-45; without one of them, 470 does not win. ASC 210-10-45-12 says current liabilities do not include long-term obligations incurred for long periods. A section-only 'ASC 470-10-45' is not a paragraph and is not asserted.

ASC 360-10-35-17 recognizes an impairment loss only when the carrying amount is not recoverable and exceeds fair value. Decoys include groups that are recoverable on undiscounted flows even though fair value is lower (no loss under 360).

The handoff 210-10-45-7 describes: the record contains a callable-debt fact, so 470 wins over 210. ASC 470-10-45-11 requires current classification of long-term obligations callable because of a covenant violation at the balance-sheet date, unless the creditor waives the right for more than one year. Contrast R03 (no such fact), which stays 210-10-45-12.

Presentation wins. The injection moves LongTermDebtNoncurrent into current liabilities and supplies no due-on-demand, callable, or refinancing fact. Unlabeled MarketableSecurities concepts may be equity securities under ASC 321, which is why this rule is expert-authored-UNVALIDATED rather than verified.

Presentation wins over 330/310. ASC 210-10-45-1 lists receivables, inventory, and prepaid expenses as current assets. Placing one of those lines in noncurrent assets violates that sentence. Subject topics measure the asset; they do not assign the section. Not linkbase-verified until paragraph_verified matches the concept.

Presentation wins. Eligible lines are operating-cycle liabilities (payables, accruals, collections in advance), which ASC 210-10-45-8 lists as current. ASC 210-10-45-5 only requires a total of current liabilities and does not govern this fault. 606 governs when deferred revenue is recognized, not which caption it uses.

ground_truth_citations.rationale: Subject wins over 210 for available-for-sale debt securities. ASC 320-10-35-1 is the subsequent-measurement sentence (fair value). ASC 210-10-45-1(f) only places marketable securities of operating cash in current assets. Unlabeled MarketableSecurities concepts may be equity securities under ASC 321, which is why this rule is expert-authored-UNVALIDATED rather than verified.

Subject wins over 210. ASC 740-10-30-5(e) reduces deferred tax assets by a valuation allowance for the portion that is more likely than not not to be realized. The facts give a realizable amount below the net asset carried. The scored code is the paragraph; (e) is the operative subparagraph.

Subject wins over 210 and 310. The facts give an expected-credit-loss estimate larger than the allowance booked. ASC 326-20-30-1 requires an allowance that presents the net amount expected to be collected. 210 only classifies receivables; 310-10-45 is presentation.

ground_truth_citations.rationale: Subject wins over 210. The facts show an asset group whose carrying amount exceeds both its undiscounted cash flows and its fair value, with no loss recorded. ASC 360-10-35-17 recognizes an impairment loss only when the carrying amount is not recoverable and exceeds fair value. Decoys include groups that are recoverable on undiscounted flows even though fair value is lower (no loss under 360).

Subject wins over 210. The injection carries goodwill without the impairment the narrative describes. ASC 350-20-35-1 is the sentence that goodwill is not amortized and is tested for impairment. Topic 210 does not measure goodwill. The loss amount is developed in later paragraphs of 350-20-35, so this citation stays expert-authored-UNVALIDATED.

Presentation wins. Eligible lines are operating-cycle liabilities (payables, accruals, collections in advance), which ASC 210-10-45-8 lists as current. ASC 210-10-45-5 only requires a total of current liabilities and does not govern this fault. 606 governs when deferred revenue is recognized, not which caption it uses.

Decoys include groups that are recoverable on undiscounted flows even though fair value is lower (no loss under 360).

ASC 230-10-45-13(c) classifies those payments as investing outflows. Topic 360 measures PPE and does not classify the cash flow. The scored code is the paragraph; subparagraph (c) is the operative sentence. A section-only 'ASC 230-10-45' is not asserted.

Presentation wins over 505. The injection moves a dividend payment or a share repurchase from financing to operating. ASC 230-10-45-15(a) lists payments of dividends and outlays to reacquire the entity's equity instruments as financing outflows. Topic 505 governs the equity accounts, not the cash-flow class.

ASC 470-10-45-11 requires current classification of long-term obligations callable because of a covenant violation at the balance-sheet date, unless the creditor waives the right for more than one year. Contrast R03 (no such fact), which stays 210-10-45-12.

Presentation wins. Eligible lines are operating-cycle liabilities (payables, accruals, collections in advance), which ASC 210-10-45-8 lists as current. ASC 210-10-45-5 only requires a total of current liabilities and does not govern this fault. 606 governs when deferred revenue is recognized, not which caption it uses.

ground_truth_citations.rationale: Subject wins over 210. The facts show an asset group whose carrying amount exceeds both its undiscounted cash flows and its fair value, with no loss recorded. ASC 360-10-35-17 recognizes an impairment loss only when the carrying amount is not recoverable and exceeds fair value. Decoys include groups that are recoverable on undiscounted flows even though fair value is lower (no loss under 360).

Presentation wins over 330/310. ASC 210-10-45-1 lists receivables, inventory, and prepaid expenses as current assets. Placing one of those lines in noncurrent assets violates that sentence. Subject topics measure the asset; they do not assign the section. Not linkbase-verified until paragraph_verified matches the concept.

ASC 360-10-35-17 recognizes an impairment loss only when the carrying amount is not recoverable and exceeds fair value. Decoys include groups that are recoverable on undiscounted flows even though fair value is lower (no loss under 360).

ground_truth_citations.rationale: Presentation wins over 330/310. ASC 210-10-45-1 lists receivables, inventory, and prepaid expenses as current assets. Placing one of those lines in noncurrent assets violates that sentence. Subject topics measure the asset; they do not assign the section. Not linkbase-verified until paragraph_verified matches the concept.

Presentation wins. Eligible lines are operating-cycle liabilities (payables, accruals, collections in advance), which ASC 210-10-45-8 lists as current. ASC 210-10-45-5 only requires a total of current liabilities and does not govern this fault. 606 governs when deferred revenue is recognized, not which caption it uses.

ground_truth_citations.rationale: Subject wins over 210 and 310. The facts give an expected-credit-loss estimate larger than the allowance booked. ASC 326-20-30-1 requires an allowance that presents the net amount expected to be collected. 210 only classifies receivables; 310-10-45 is presentation.

Presentation wins. The injection moves LongTermDebtNoncurrent into current liabilities and supplies no due-on-demand, callable, or refinancing fact. ASC 210-10-45-7 hands only those three facts to 470-10-45; without one of them, 470 does not win. ASC 210-10-45-12 says current liabilities do not include long-term obligations incurred for long periods. A section-only 'ASC 470-10-45' is not a paragraph and is not asserted.

Placing one of those lines in noncurrent assets violates that sentence. Subject topics measure the asset; they do not assign the section. Presentation wins. The injection moves LongTermDebtNoncurrent into current liabilities and supplies no due-on-demand, callable, or refinancing fact. ASC 210-10-45-7 hands only those three facts to 470-10-45; without one of them, 470 does not win. ASC 210-10-45-12 says current liabilities do not include long-term obligations incurred for long periods. A section-only 'ASC 470-10-45' is not a paragraph and is not asserted.
